title: llm.toolcall.executed.v2
description: Audit fact (D-26, FR-54): the AI called one read-only MCP tool. Replaces llm.toolcall.executed.v1 (deprecated, D-44): the scope values tenant and platform-admin are now org and operator. CloudEvents subject: the conversation id. The actor extension names the user. No tool arguments and no tool results: they can hold personal data.

scope.description: Token scope of the call (D-14). org, never tenant; operator, never platform-admin (D-44).

outcome.description: ok: the tool answered. denied: the scope did not allow the tool. error: the tool failed.
